title: RNR: Teaching Large Language Models to Follow Roles and Rules
reasoning: The paper focuses on a data generation pipeline (RoleNRules) and benchmarks (RNR-Expert, RNR-Awesome, RNR-AlpacaFarm) to improve the role and rule following abilities of LLMs. While it includes a single evaluation example involving biblical facts for fact-checking on page 19, it does not systematically evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning.
